```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(mvtnorm)
library(pracma)
library(here)

source(here("mogp-utils.R"))
```

The purpose of this notebook is to generate draws from a multi-output spectral mixture Gaussian process with known hyperparameter values:

- $w_i$: magnitude/weight
- $\Sigma_i$: spectral width/variance
- $\mu_i$: spectral frequency/mean
- $\theta_i$: delay
- $\phi_i$: phase


```{r}
D <- 2
Q <- 1
num_points <- 100
noise_sigma <- 0.4
pct_missing <- 0.5

SEED <- 5672 #round(runif(1, min = 0, max = 9999))

output_df <- simulate_mogp(D, Q, num_points, noise_sigma, seed = SEED, masked_pct = pct_missing)

output_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t, y = y, alpha = ifelse(masked, 0.2, 1), colour = d) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = paste("Seed =", SEED), alpha = "Observed", colour = "Band")
```

```{r}
output_filename <- glue("D{D}-Q{Q}-seed{SEED}-mogp-mcar{pct_missing}-sigma{noise_sigma}-sim.csv")
write_csv(
  output_df |>
    filter(!masked) |> 
    select(-masked), 
  here("data", output_filename))
```
